mapper.select: select customer_id from app_customer where customer_id=#{customerId} and (#{admin}=true or consultant_id=#{consultantId}) and del_flag='0' for update
select actor_user_id actorUserId, customer_id customerId, payload_hash payloadHash from app_crm_event where request_id=#{requestId} for update
mapper.update: update app_crm_task set title=#{title},due_at=#{dueAt},status=#{status},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} where task_id=#{entityId} and customer_id=#{customerId} and version=#{version}
update app_crm_task set status='done',version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} where task_id=#{completeTaskId} and customer_id=#{customerId} and version=#{taskVersion} and status='pending'
update app_crm_opportunity set title=#{title},stage=#{stage},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} where opportunity_id=#{entityId} and customer_id=#{customerId} and version=#{version}
